entities.name: Alberto Fernández Díaz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alberto Fernández Díaz is a Spanish former politician of the People's Party (PP). He was a member of the City Council of Barcelona from 1987 to 1999 and again from 2003 to 2019, and led his party in the Parliament of Catalonia between his two mandates.
